"fence"}], "rationale": "Weight-stationary dataflow, n-blocks outer, k-blocks inner per m-block. All three A(m0,k) tiles persist in scratchpad rows 0-47 for the entire run; a single 16-row streaming slot (rows 48-63) alternates between the current B(k,n) tile and the current A(m1,k) tile. Each B(k,n) is loaded once, used by the (m0,n,k) compute (which latches it), and the (m1,n,k) compute then reuses the latched B via accumulated=true with a GARBAGE preload, so the A(m1,k) mvin may overwrite the B scratchpad copy. Per C tile the computes run k=0 (overwrite, initializing the accumulator) then k=1,2 (accumulate), giving the exact K=48 ordered reduction; both C tiles of the n-block are mvout once each after k=2. Total mvins: 3 persistent A(m0) + 9 streamed A(m1) + 9 B = 21 tiles x 256 bytes = 5376 DMA input bytes (a strict lower bound: 9 B tiles must each load once, and at most 3 of 6 A tiles can persist across n-blocks within the 64-row scratchpad), with 68 commands and a final fence."}
